CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cerious DevTech Community Applications repository.
This repository provides the official Unraid Community Applications template for Cerious AASM (Ark: Survival Ascended Server Manager), a self-hosted server management application with a web interface, SteamCMD/Proton support, and management tooling for dedicated ARK servers.
Project and support: https://github.com/ryoucerious/cerious-aasm
